page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Full-width ornamental frieze at the top, then the title block (work title, "DE", "LIBERTATE."), then a large-initial opening paragraph, a decorative band, the chapter heading "CAPVT PRIMVM." with an italic subtitle, and a final paragraph. main_text.l: MVLTI, tum Philosophi Ethnici, tum The-
ologi Christiani, de libertate liberè philosophati
sunt. Quamvis autem ex variis & contrariis eo-
rum scriptis, huic doctrinæ enodandæ non pa-
nanda eos reliquisse non dubito. Quamobrem
ergo vestigiis eorum insistens, & aliquando ab
iis deflectens; aliquid novi in hac materia tra-
dere, aut jam traditum clariùs explicare proposui; ut quid de ea sen-
tiendum sit, tutò ac facilius dignoscatur. Primò, autem agam de ac-

tionibus quarum cognitio necessaria est ad intelligentiam libertatis. Secundò, de libertate in genere. Tertiò, de libertate Dei. Quartò, de libertate creaturæ intelligentis, ac potissimùm hominis, in genere. Quintò, de libertate hominis in quolibet statu.

l.i: De Actionibus Quarum Cognitio Necessaria est ad Intelligentiam Libertatis.

main_text.l: ACtiones quarum cognitio necessaria est ad intelligentiam liber-
tatis sunt. 1. Naturalis & violenta. 2. Spontanea & coacta. 3.
Voluntaria & involuntaria. 4. Libera & necessaria. De quibus quanta fieri poterit
brevitate & claritate tractabimus, incipientes à naturali.

page.notes: Ornamental friezes and the decorated initials M and A are not text. The large initials are joined to their words as printed ("ACtiones"). The marginal numbers "1.", "2." and "3." are section numbers in the margin; the "3." beside the line "3. Voluntaria" may be the printed marginal number or the in-text enumeration, so I placed it as a note and kept the in-text "3." as printed. The printed run-on "luminisaffulisse" is a printing error, left as printed. Digitiser watermark at the bottom right excluded.
